src.alt: Scalloped-top wood privacy fence with post caps running along a new backyard

hr-ld.paragraph: Wood privacy, vinyl, black metal, chain link and split rail fences, plus custom gates and arbors, for homes and businesses around Columbia.

tz0-p.paragraph: Board-on-rail, dog-ear, shadowbox and capped privacy fences in pressure-treated pine, stepped to follow the grade.

tz1-p.paragraph: Walk gates, double drive gates, arched metal driveway gates and pergola arbors with lattice sides.

tz2-p.paragraph: White vinyl privacy fencing with matching X-brace gates and black hinges and latches.

tz3-p.paragraph: Black aluminum picket fencing with self-latching gates, and privacy fencing around pools.

tz4-p.paragraph: Rail fencing for wooded lots and farm lanes, chain link yards, and commercial gates and enclosures.

oz-h.title: Call Chris, not a call center.

src.alt: Chris, owner of Advanced Fence Service, on a job with a core drill

oz-ld.paragraph: Advanced Fence Service is Chris's fence company in Columbia. You talk to him about the job, the materials and the price, and he's on site for the work.

oz-p.paragraph: Wood, vinyl, aluminum or chain link, the work is the same: posts set solid, lines straight and gates that close the way they should.
